title: Provincial Employees Social Security Amendment Ordinance 2021

sections.shortTitle: Provincial Employees Social Security Amendment Ordinance 2021
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 732
PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 732
ORDINANCE XI OF 2021
PROVINCIAL EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2021
An Ordinance to amend the Provincial Employees'
Social Security Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
22nd February, 2021]
No.
Legis:13-22/15(P-I), dated 22.2.2021.---The following Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is
hereby published for general information:
It
is necessary to amend the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
(X of 1965) for extending the scope of the hospitals of Provincial Employees'
Social Security Institution to general public; for making certain modifications
for better and smooth Implementation of Ordinance X of 1965; and for the
ancillary matters.
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be cited as the Provincial Employees' Social Security (Amendment)
Ordinance 2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of Ordinance X of 1965

action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
2. Amendment
of Ordinance X of 1965.---In the
Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance 1965 (X of 1965), for brevity
referred to as the 'Ordinance':
(a) in
the long title, for the words "and for matters ancillary thereto",
the expression ", and for providing healthcare to the general public"
shall be substituted;
(b) in
the preamble, after the expression "death,", the expression "for
providing healthcare to the general public,", shall be inserted;
(c) for
the words "secured person" wherever appearing, the words
"secured employee" shall be substituted;
(d) for
the words "secured persons" wherever appearing, the words
"secured employees" shall be substituted;
(e) for
the expression "self-assessment scheme" wherever appearing, the
expression "Self-Assessment Scheme" shall be substituted;
(f) for
the words "secured woman" wherever appearing, the words "female
secured employee" shall be substituted;
(g) in
subsection (1) of section 35, in section 36, in section 39, in subsection (1)
of section 40 and in subsection (1) of section 41, for the expression
"Government by notification, in consultation with the Institution"
the words "Governing Body" shall be substituted; and
(h) in
Chapter V-A, in the heading, for the word "SERVANTS", the word
"WORKERS" shall be substituted.

It
is necessary to amend the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965

Social Security Institution to general public; for making certain modifications

Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the Punjab is

action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
3. Amendment
of section 2 of Ordinance X of 1965.---In the Ordinance, in section 2:
(a) after
clause (2), the following clause (2a) shall be inserted:
"(2a)
"Chief Minister" means Chief Minister of the Punjab;";
(b) for
clause (7-a), the following shall be substituted:
"(7a)
"domestic worker" means a domestic worker as defined in the Punjab
Domestic Workers Act 2019 (II of 2019);";
(c) after
clause (12), the following clause (12a) shall be inserted:
"(12a)
"general public" means individuals other than the secured employees
and their dependents;";
(d) after
clause (16), the following clause (16a) and clause (16b) shall be inserted:
"(16a)
local authority means a:
(i) land
control authority established by any law for the time being in force to
regulate or manage land use; or
(ii) a
local government; or
(iii) a
company set up by the Government to provide land related services;
(16b)
"local government" means a local government constituted under the
Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 (XIII of 2019) or any other law for the time
being in force;";
(e) after
clause (24), the following clause (24a) shall be inserted:
"(24a)
"Secretary" means Secretary to the Government, Labour and Human
Resource Department,";
(f) in
clause (25a), the words "no intervention through" shall be omitted,
and after the word "Institution", the expression "subject to
subsection (4) of section 22" shall be inserted;
(g) in
clause (29), for the expression "Industrial Disputes Ordinance, 1959 (LVI
of 1959)" the expression "Punjab Industrial Relations Act, 2010 (XIX
of 2010)" shall be substituted; and
(h) In
clause (30) for the expression "Minimum Wages Ordinance, 1961 (XXXIX of
1961)" the expression "Punjab Minimum Wages Act 2019 (XXVIII of
2019)" shall be substituted.
